request.style: English, male solo voice with warm choir, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, cello, hopeful and gentle mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Let love be genuine and true
Hate what is evil, hold fast to good
Be devoted to one another
Outdo one another in honor

[Verse]
Never let your zeal grow slack
Be fervent in spirit
Serve the Lord with all your heart

[Chorus]
Rejoice in hope
Endure in affliction
Persevere in prayer

[Verse]
Share with the saints in their needs
Pursue hospitality always
Bless those who persecute you
Bless them and do not curse them

[Chorus]
Rejoice in hope
Endure in affliction
Persevere in prayer

[Bridge]
Rejoice with those who rejoice
Weep with those who weep
United in faith

[Outro]
Rejoice in hope
Persevere in prayer
